verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability's own docs say it includes zero-config anomaly detection and can detect outliers in logs through categorization and anomaly detection, which matches surfacing problems without hand-written thresholds. The evidence is only brief overview-level claims, so how SREs enable it, which signals beyond logs it covers, and how anomalies are surfaced or alerted on are not shown. missing for 10: documented steps for enabling anomaly detection jobs, coverage of metrics/APM signals beyond logs, anomaly-based alerting rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can enable anomaly or outlier detection that surfaces problems without hand-written thresholds

citations.quote: This includes zero-config anomaly detection, pattern analysis, and the ability to surface correlations and root causes.
detect patterns and outliers with categorization and anomaly detection
